constraints.claim: Otherwise-identical evidence with more pure support must not reduce net-quality score.
Otherwise-identical evidence with more pure pressure must not increase net-quality score.
For a broadly supportive major, Hãm must not raise the support axis relative to Miếu on the same star identity.
Adding specifically identified major malefics should preserve pressure; admitted malefic evidence must remain visible.
A source-described mixed condition (support plus pressure/activation) must not collapse into a clean unopposed supportive state.
Adding natal Hóa Lộc with positive support seed must not reduce quality versus the same chart without that transform, holding other evidence fixed. Not an expected score.
High activation alone must not raise net-quality.
